title: CulturalTeaming: AI-Assisted Interactive Red-Teaming for Challenging LLMs’ (Lack of) Multicultural Knowledge
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking 'multicultural knowledge' and 'cultural norms'. This evaluation includes knowledge of religious traditions and practices as a component of cultural proficiency, specifically tracking religious affiliation demographics and including religious subgroups like 'Islamic cultures' and 'Muslim' in its classification of cultures.
